question: The square root of the sum of squares of two numbers is 25. If one number is 15, find the other number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The relation √(a² + b²) = c represents a Pythagorean triplet a, b, c.

The standard triplet ratio is 3 : 4 : 5.

Given values: 15 and 25 are multiples of 3 and 5 (3 × 5 = 15 and 5 × 5 = 25).

The missing part of the ratio is 4. ∴ Other number = 4 × 5 = 20.

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: One number = 15, Square root of sum of squares = 25

Formula: √(x² + y²) = z ⇒ x² + y² = z²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/932423794b17c3cc7b0c982b8870a14f2f17646a8d243fc3554b01a34e0b0da4.png] 

⇒ √(15² + x²) = 25

⇒ 15² + x² = 25²

⇒ 225 + x² = 625

⇒ x² = 625 − 225

⇒ x² = 400

⇒ x = √400 = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Triplets

Sets of three positive integers a, b, and c such that a² + b² = c². Examples: (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (8, 15, 17), (7, 24, 25).

Squares and Square Roots

Calculating the square root is the inverse operation of squaring a number. √x² = x for any positive number x.

Hypotenuse Property

In any right-angled triangle, the hypotenuse is the longest side and is opposite the 90° angle.
